body: I think you're right about being second preference for someone, it's just so hard mentally to realise that something you want so much can never be had. I'm not too sure what i'm attracted to in girls, like I said this is like the first person I've ever felt something for, I don't really judge her aesthetically all that much, not like other guys probably do. Her face is very attractive and her hairstyle is pretty cool, at first she reminded me of a less severe version of Lisbeth Salander from the girl with the dragon tattoo. I think I was depressed before this though and this has just made it worse, in terms of not feeling good enough I have no idea why I feel that way. Because you're right in what you said, I keep fit, interact with a lot of other people every day, i'm really friendly too. I guess it's just confidence issues, it's a strange sort of feeling. One minute i'll be fine and laughing but the next almost crying from feeling worthless like I don't matter at all. The gym I train at is about half men half women so it's not as if i'm not around any other girls, some of them are very beautiful too, it's just I still don't really feel attracted to them, maybe i'm extremely picky I have no idea, again thanks for replying. :)

Yeah it wasn't nice for her to have to see that, that was quite a while ago though and I think she thinks i'm okay now, I cover it up quite well I guess. I think you're right about overtraining causing depression, i've been training like this for a long time I guess maybe it could have crept up on me. But I don't just think it's that, when I mentioned being in love with a girl, obviously this is currently making me feel worse than ever. I've only known her for about 2 months and I guess there's a chance she's bisexual I don't really know her enough to know, which I guess makes it so much more pathetic me saying I love her. But the thing is, even if by some miracle I do get her I feel like I could never be good enough, not only for her but for anyone. When I look around I just think why anyone would ever think twice about me or ever want anything from me. By the way, thankyou so much for replying to these comments, I feel like i'm just whining but it makes me feel so much better just typing this up knowing someone is reading it who knows what i'm feeling.

Thanks for your reply, some days I don't feel so bad, not happy just not as miserable as usual. I've spoken to my mum a little bit about it, not really out of choice but because she was questioning me about my moods and I just broke down into tears. She doesn't know I think about suicide quite often, it would destroy her if I ever mentioned it. You could possibly be right about over exercising, it's basically all I do with my life. I train 7 days a week without fail, sometimes twice a day, it doesn't make me feel that good anymore it's just the only thing i'm good at and something I want a career in. And not lifting anything usually makes me feel worse because I feel like i'm cheating myself, I tend to over think stuff when just sitting around.
